# Frozen MATLAB native Feature fixture

`native-legacy-enum-feature.mat` is an unchanged copy of the native fixture from
the sealed 2026-09-11 MATLAB R2026a baseline at source
`ac4a67ecfea16c06e4f87e9fc68c06815f5eda20`.

Original and copied SHA256:
`8f7ae6f6a1468bfe4d4e4b2b1083bd0e402a3a5cee6dd2f40e6d4ae1cfd9bc25`.

It contains native `FeatureOptionKey.N_RUNS`, enum-valued key/value records,
string-keyed options, an old standalone noisy Feature (resolved count 3,
noise level 0.001), and native `@sin`. The key record does not assert that a
MATLAB struct or containers.Map supports enum keys. No live FeaturedProblem
is saved. It was captured through native save/load, not regenerated by the
new implementation. Same-version baseline capture is not evidence that a
future implementation or every supported MATLAB release accepts the fixture.

Native MAT loading and the explicit import helper are trusted-input boundaries.
